desc: A real bullet flyby sound from a shooting range heard after a burst from an M240 type machine gun around 3:14-3:16 extracted from Ukrainian troops improve their trench-clearing tactics at Norwegian training camp in Poland (b-roll) (Nov 9, 2025) - Natochannel. I don't know what the actual cause of the sound is but it sure sounds like a cinematic bullet fly-by and it was recorded right after a gunfire burst on a shooting range. Unfortunately there seems to be a vocal 'a' or something like that audible at the same time. But perhaps it is still usable, at least as an example or for cleanup.
title: Real Bullet Flyby Sound
author: qubodup
